events.title: YuanRong Playtest Coming in Late September
events.summary: Hello everyone,Development on YuanRong is now approximately 75% complete. After ongoing development and refinement, we plan to launch our first Playtest in late September 2026.This test will help us validate core gameplay, controls, and overall stability. Please note that the test build is still in development and does not represent the final quality of the game. We will carefully review your feedback and continue improving YuanRong.The exact release date and participation details will be shared
